newsitem.title: UK: Fund managers optimistic on UK economy-M.Lynch.
newsitem.headline: Fund managers optimistic on UK economy-M.Lynch.

text.p: UK fund managers remain optimistic about the outlook for the British economy over the coming year, according to a Merrill Lynch/Gallup survey released on Monday.
It said 82 percent expect an improvement in the general economic situation but were bearish about inflation, with all but one of those surveyed predicting it would be higher in a year's time.
"As a result the vast majority of managers -- 89 percent -- expect rates to be higher in a year's time," it added.
Preferences were swinging towards the UK engineering sector and away from retailiers, while utility stocks remain unloved, the survey said.
Commenting on asset allocation elsewhere, only nine percent wanted to sell U.S. equities compared to 31 percent in May.
However, Pacific Basin equities remain out of favour with a balance of just four percent looking to increase their exposure to the region.
